name: pj
description: CLI SVG editor for the software design course

scripts.build:plugins: tsc -p tsconfig.plugin-api.json && npm --prefix plugins/plugin-stats run build && npm --prefix plugins/plugin-dir run build && npm --prefix plugins/plugin-shape-box run build && npm --prefix plugins/plugin-tree-star run build
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.cjs plugins/plugin-stats/tests/*.test.cjs plugins/plugin-dir/tests/*.test.cjs plugins/plugin-shape-box/tests/*.test.cjs plugins/plugin-tree-star/tests/*.test.cjs
